description: This file defines the main dashboard page component for a React-based frontend application. It manages state related to projects, metrics, suggestions, filters, and loading/error states. It fetches data from APIs, handles project selection, and renders various UI components such as header, metrics overview, charts, problem list, and suggestions panel, orchestrating the dashboard's overall functionality.

methods.name: initialFilters
methods.description: Initializes the filter state with default values for dashboard filtering options.

methods.name: handleDocTypeChange
methods.description: Updates the 'docType' filter based on user selection.

methods.name: handleSelectProject
methods.description: Handles project selection and triggers data reload for the selected project.
